key_insight: DFT screening identifies condition-dependent stabilization routes for ordered MXenes that are thermodynamically inaccessible under equilibrium reference conditions.
engineering_relevance: Temperature, pressure, and carbon chemical potential offer targeted synthesis levers, while the dataset supports future machine-learned stability descriptors.
method: Computed 1,040 ordered binary and ternary bare, delaminated MXenes using r²SCAN DFT.
Calculated formation and decomposition Gibbs energies, decomposition products, layer symmetries, and energies above the hull.
Evaluated stabilization under elevated temperature, high pressure, and varied carbon chemical potential.
evidence_signal: The calculations predict stabilization of 115 predominantly carbide MXenes at 500–2000 K, 23 at 10 GPa, and three Mn–Fe–C MXenes within experimentally feasible carbon chemical potentials.
watch_item: Predicted thermodynamic stabilization does not establish experimental synthesizability; bare-sheet models omit surface terminations and synthesis kinetics.
paper_title: High-Fidelity In Silico Dataset of Ordered Binary and Ternary MXenes with Predictive Synthesis Guidance
